active.description: Marks this column as the one currently sorted: the label and chevron take the accent color. It does not sort anything on its own.

direction.description: Which chevron to draw: up for "asc", down for "desc". It also sets the icon's aria-label.

hideSortIcon.description: Leaves the chevron out for columns that cannot be sorted. An active header keeps its chevron even with this set.

horizontalAlign.description: Horizontally aligns the label and its chevron.

hover.description: Makes the header interactive: it takes a pointer cursor, reacts to hover, renders the sort chevron and allows the tooltip. A header left at the default draws no chevron and shows no tooltip even if the other sorting props are set, so set this on every sortable column.

shouldShowTooltipOnHover.description: Wraps the header in a Tooltip. It only takes effect while hover is also true.

tooltipProps.description: Passed to the Tooltip, and overrides the defaults the header sets (arrow, top-start placement, dark style).
